content: Yooseefenne Iza Ishata
Yaaqoobey kase ba aaway deyida Kanaane biittan uttides.

Yaaqoobe nayti hanidayssi hayssafe kaallidi xaafettidayssa. Yooseefey 17 layththa naa gidida wode ba aawaa aylletappe, Bilihappenne Zilfife yelettida ba ishatara ba aawa meheta heemmees; he wode izi ba aawaas istti ooththida iita miish ehi yootees.
Isra7eeley Yooseefe cimateththan yelida gishshas hankko attuma nayta ubbaafe aaththi siiqees; izi izas alleqo may7o giigsides.
Iza ishati istta aaway iza isttafe aaththi siiqizayssa be7idi istti iza ixxidi lo7o qaalan izara haasayanaas dandaybeettenna.
Yooseefey agumo agumettidi ba ishatas yootides; isttika iza gede gujji ixxida.
Izi isttas, «Tani agumettida agumo siyite.
Nuni gade giddon kaththa mirqqe mirqqishin ta mirqqeya dendada sitti ga eqqadus; intte mirqqeti gidikko yuuyi aadhdhidi ta mirqqeysi ziggida» gides.
Iza ishati iza, «Neni nu bolla kawotana hanay? Woykko nuna tumu haarana hanay?» gida; istti iza agumoza gishshassinne izi isttas yootida qaalaa gishshas kaseppe iza aaththi ixxida.
Qasseka Yooseefey hara agumo agumettidi ba ishanttas yootides; «Siyite; tani hara agumokka agumettadis; he agumozan arshey, aginaynne 11 xoolintteti taas ziggishin be7adis» gides.

He izi be7ida agumoza ba aawassinne ba ishatas yootiin iza aaway iza, «Hayssi neni agumettidayssi ay agumoo? Tumu tani, ne aayeyanne ne ishati yiidi ne sinththan sa7an gufannidi nees zigganee?» gi hanqettides.
Iza ishati iza miqqaynida; gido attiin iza aaway ha yo7oza ba wozinan woththidi naagides.
Yooseefe Bayzeteth
Issi gallas iza ishati Seekeeme achchan ba aawaa meheta heemmanaas biin,
Isra7eeley Yooseefe, «Ne ishati Seekeemen mehe heemmizayssa ne eraasa; haa ya; ta nena isttako kiittana» gides. Yooseefeykka, «Ero» gides.
Yaaqoobeykka, «Baada ne ishatinne mehey saro dizaakko be7a yaada istta hanota taas yoota» giidi iza Kebroone shoobba kiittiin izi Seekeeme bides.
Heen demba giddon izi gede haa simerettishin issi asi iza demmidi, «Naazoo! Ay koyay?» gi oychchides.
Izikka, «Ta ishata koyays; istti mehe heemmizasohoy awakko taas yootarkkii!» gides.
Histtiin addezi, «Hessafe dendichchida; isttas, ‹Nuni Dootaane boos› gishin siyadis» gides; hessa gishshas Yooseefey ba ishata guye biidi istta Dootaanen demmides.
Gido attiin izi haahon dishin istti iza be7ida; izi isttako gakkontta dishin istti iza wodhanaas maqettida.
Issoy issaas, «Be7ite! Agumo goday yees.
Haa yiite! Iza wodhidi ha ollatappe issaa giddo yeggoos. Hessafe guye, ‹Iita do7ay iza mides› gaana; histtidi iza agumoy polettiin ane be7ana» gida.
Oroobeeley hessa siyidi istta kusheppe iza ashshanaas koyidi, «Iza wodho wodhdhoko;
Suuth gussofte; iza intte bazzon diza ha ollaa giddo yeggite; iza bolla kushe woththofte» gides. Oroobeeley iza istta kusheppe ashshidi guye iza aawaakko yeddanaas qoppides.
Yooseefey ba ishataakko gakkida wode izi may7ida alleqo may7o izappe qaari ekkida;
iza efidi haaththi baynda mela ollan yeggida.
Istti ba qumaa maanaas uttidaashe Isma7eele dere asati Gibxe baanaas Gala7aadeppe yizayta dhoqqu giidi be7ida; istti ba gaamellan sawo, balasaane geetettiza dhalenne karbbe caani woththida.
Yuhuday ba ishata, «Nuni nu ishaa wodhidi iza suuththaa qottiko nuna ay maaddanee?
Haa yiite; iza Isma7eeletas bayzoos; iza bolla nu kushe woththoko; gaasoykka izi nu ishanne nu asho.» Histtiin iza ishati wurikka ero gida.
Hessa gishshas Midiyaame biitta zal7anchchati hessara aadhdhishin iza ishati Yooseefe ollaafe kessidi Isma7eele asatas 20 biras bayziin istti Yooseefe Gibxe biitta efida.
Oroobeeley ollaako simmidi Yooseefey heen bayndayssa be7ida wode ceecidi ba may7o daakkides
Izi guye ba ishataakko biidi, «Naazi heen baawa; ha7i ta awa simma boo!» gides.
Hessafe guye istti issi deysh ekki shukkidi Yooseefe may7o suuththan maadhida.
Iza aleqo may7oza aawaakko efidi aawaas, «Nuni hayssa demmi ekkidos; hayssi ne naaza may7okkonne harakko ane xeella» gida.
Aawaykka may7ozi Yooseefeyssa gididayssa eridi, «Ee hayssi ta naaza may7o! Iita do7ay iza michchides; tumukka Yooseefe do7ay puuzereththi montta aggenna» gides.
Yaaqoobeykka mishettidi ba may7o peedhi yeggides; maaqa may7idi daro wode gakkanaas ba naazas yeekkides.
Iza attuma naytinne macca nayti wuri iza minththeththanaas izakko yida; gido attiin izi minettontta ixxidi, «Hanenna! Tani yeekkada ta naakko baada duufon gelana» giidi iza aaway izas yeekkides.
He wode Midiyaame biitta asati Yooseefe Gibxe kawo oosanchcha Phixifaaras Gibxen bayzida; Phixifaaraykka zabeta halaqa.
